[[File:Harmony Island Teleport icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Harmony Island Teleport''' teleports the caster to [[Harmony Island]].

In order to cast this spell, players must have spoken to [[Tyss]] to unlock the [[Arceuus spellbook]]. In addition, completion of [[The Great Brain Robbery]] is required to cast the spell as well.

The teleport is useful for players that have completed the [[elite Morytania Diary]], as they can use the herb patch located on the island.
